description: 1k ohm, linear-taper, 16mm-body panel-mount potentiometer, solid (smooth, non-knurled) round metal shaft, 6.35mm dia x 15mm long, solder-lug terminals

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: exact match for RV16AF-10-15R1-B1K-3CLA (Alpha (Taiwan)), Mouser part 313-2000F-1K, in stock 720 units.

Taiwan Alpha Electronic's own 'RV16A01F / RV16AF - 16mm Rotary Type, Metal Shaft Series' catalog PDF, 2026-09-30, 'How to order' diagram: the order code's Taper-and-Resistance field 'B1K' decodes as taper code B and resistance value 1K ohm.
Same catalog PDF, 'How to order' diagram's Taper and Resistance Value table: order code prefix 'B' = 'Linear/B' taper (A = Log, B = Linear, C = Rev-log).

Same catalog PDF: the whole series is titled '16mm Rotary Type, Metal Shaft Series' throughout, and the RV16AF-10 outline drawing (page 2) dimensions the case as a 16.5mm diameter body with a 17mm mounting-bushing face, consistent with the operator's 16mm panel-pot default.

why: Paired with potentiometer-25k-linear-panel-pot (same board, RV7/RV5 DRIVE and TRANSFORMER DRIVE; this part is RV6 CHARACTER) - see that entry's 'why' for the full account of the family choice and the PCB-pin-versus-solder-lug deviation from the operator's default. In short: Taiwan Alpha's RV16AF-10-15R1-B family is the only one found across Alpha, Bourns and Piher that carries both this board's panel-pot values (1k and 25k) in Mouser stock at hobbyist quantities with a genuinely solid (non-knurled, non-flatted) round metal shaft and a 16mm body, confirmed from the manufacturer's own catalog PDF. The only stocked PCB-pin Alpha variant of this exact shaft/taper/body combination (RV16AF-42-15R1-B, right-angle PC mount) is in stock at Mouser for 100k only, not 1k or 25k, so it could not cover this line.
